# Canada.ca

> The official Government of Canada portal providing integrated access to federal services, legislation, research funding, and national security oversight.

Canada.ca serves as the primary digital gateway for Canadian government services and information. It encompasses employment and social development programs, defence procurement oversight, research coordination, trade and labour mobility initiatives, and accessibility standards development.

## Key Topics

- Government of Canada
- Employment and Social Development
- Defence Acquisition
- One Canadian Economy Act
- Interprovincial Trade
- Labour Mobility
- Intelligence Commissioner
- Research Funding Ecosystem
- Accessibility Standards
- Privacy and Access to Information
- Military Procurement
- CPP and Employment Insurance
- Seniors Programs
- Bill C-5 Free Trade Legislation
- National Security Oversight

## Core Government Services

- [Home - Canada.ca](https://www.canada.ca/en.html): Government of Canada portal providing access to services, benefits, and information
- [Accueil - Canada.ca](https://www.canada.ca/fr.html): French-language homepage for Government of Canada services and information
- [Employment and Social Development Canada - Canada.ca](https://www.canada.ca/en/employment-social-development.html): ESDC main page covering employment, benefits, pensions, and family support
- [Programs and initiatives for seniors - Canada.ca](https://www.canada.ca/en/employment-social-development/corporate/seniors.html): ESDC seniors programs including caregiving benefits and tax credits

## Trade and Economic Development

- [One Canadian Economy - Canada.ca](https://www.canada.ca/en/one-canadian-economy.html): Main page on One Canadian Economy Act and interprovincial trade initiatives
- [Free Trade and Labour Mobility in Canada Act - One Canadian Economy - Canada.ca](https://www.canada.ca/en/one-canadian-economy/services/free-trade-labour-mobility-canada-act.html): Information on Bill C-5 legislation for interprovincial trade and labour mobility
- [Frequently asked questions about the One Canadian Economy Act - One Canadian Economy - Canada.ca](https://www.canada.ca/en/one-canadian-economy/services/answers-top-questions-about-one-canadian-economy-act.html): FAQ on One Canadian Economy Act covering trade, labour, and regulatory reform

## Defence and Security Oversight

- [Independent Review Panel for Defence Acquisition - Canada.ca](https://www.canada.ca/en/independent-review-panel-defence-acquisition.html): Overview of Independent Review Panel for Defence Acquisition and military procurement
- [Mandate of the Independent Review Panel for Defence Acquisition - Canada.ca](https://www.canada.ca/en/independent-review-panel-defence-acquisition/corporate/mandate.html): Official mandate of Independent Review Panel for Defence Acquisition
- [Independent Review Panel for Defence Acquisition Annual Reports - Canada.ca](https://www.canada.ca/en/independent-review-panel-defence-acquisition/services/annual-reports.html): Annual reports on defence procurement observations and key findings
- [Cybersecurity Authorization - Canada.ca](https://www.canada.ca/en/intelligence-commissioner/oversight-en/cybersecurity.html): CSE cybersecurity authorization and Intelligence Commissioner oversight
- [Notes for Remarks to the Standing Committee on Public Safety and National Security - Canada.ca](https://www.canada.ca/en/intelligence-commissioner/notesforremarsktothesecu.html): Intelligence Commissioner testimony on Bill C-70 and national security oversight

## Research and Innovation

- [Canada's research funding ecosystem - Canada.ca](https://www.canada.ca/en/research-coordinating-committee/corporate/canadas-research-funding-ecosystem.html): Overview of federal research funding agencies including CIHR, NSERC, SSHRC, CFI
- [Strengthening equity, diversity and inclusion in research - Canada.ca](https://www.canada.ca/en/research-coordinating-committee/priorities/equity-diversity-inclusion-research.html): CRCC position on equity, diversity, and inclusion in Canadian research

## Accessibility and Standards

- [Accessibility Standards Canada](https://www.canada.ca/en/accessibility-standards-canada.html): Accessibility Standards Canada organization developing standards for accessibility
- [Accessibility - Canada.ca](https://www.canada.ca/en/intelligence-commissioner/accessibility.html): Intelligence Commissioner accessibility plan and barrier removal progress

## Privacy, Transparency, and Procurement

- [Access to Information and Privacy - Canada.ca](https://www.canada.ca/en/intelligence-commissioner/transparency/atip-annualreport.html): Intelligence Commissioner annual reports on access to information and privacy
- [Contracting Information for Suppliers - Canada.ca](https://www.canada.ca/en/employment-social-development/corporate/contracting.html): ESDC supplier contracting information and government procurement terms

## Optional

- [Terms and conditions - Canada.ca](https://www.canada.ca/en/transparency/terms.html): Copyright, permissions, and legal terms for Canada.ca content usage
- [Avis - Canada.ca](https://www.canada.ca/fr/transparence/avis.html): French legal notices covering copyright and website disclaimer information
